craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of containment — the Vijñānavāda opponent staged at full strength, then held; śāstra-hammer couplets, negation-anaphora, terminal doctrine words. Concession as device; prayojana→the end keeps BOUNDARY open (whose end unresolved). Rejected: (a) resolving whose purpose → killed by BOUNDARY. (b) heightened diction → killed: concession is flat by design. Read aloud: GRANT-ed — LET-no-MARK-stand … AND-that-MUCH SERVES the-END.

lines: Granted — let no mark stand. Yet here a difference succeeds,
from appearing's coming and going — and that much serves the end.
l4.sanskrit_cite: mā bhūd viśeṣaḥ prakhyādibhāvābhāvau tataḥ punaḥ siddhyaty eva viśeṣo 'tra tāvatā ca prayojanam

reads_against.argmap: Granted no difference — does the dispute collapse? → Concession costs nothing: a purpose-serving difference survives the grant.
c1_essence: Every candidate seat of distinction — predicates, objecthood, conceded difference, free-standing being, function — collapses into knower-dependence; the opponent's no-difference is granted, then outflanked from inside (vv1-8).
Grasping-less awareness is declared inert, and the proof turns: only self-reflective consciousness can stand as ground (v9).
